faq.q: What's on a card beyond a title?
faq.a: Each card can hold a description, a priority (High/Medium/Low, shown as a coloured left border), a due date (overdue cards are flagged), an assignee, comma-separated tags, a colour label, and a checklist of sub-items with a done/total progress count. Cards also track a per-card time spent via a Start/Stop timer. You can duplicate or archive cards, and drag them within or between columns (mouse or touch).

faq.q: Can I set work-in-progress limits on columns?
faq.a: Yes. Each column has an optional WIP limit (0 = none) set in its settings along with a name and colour. When a column's card count exceeds its limit, the column is outlined in red and its count badge turns red — a visual cue to stop starting new work. You can also reorder, rename and delete columns, and start boards from templates like Simple, Software Sprint, Study Plan, Job Application Tracker or Content Pipeline.

faq.q: Can I run more than one board, and is my data stored anywhere?
faq.a: Yes, create unlimited boards (duplicate names are auto-suffixed) and switch between them. Everything is saved to your browser's localStorage under kanban_data_v2 — nothing is uploaded, so clearing browser data erases it; use export for backups. Filters let you search card text and narrow by priority, tag, or due status (overdue/today/this week).

faq.q: How do I export or share a board?
faq.a: You can export a board as JSON (and re-import it), copy it as plain text for a standup, copy it as Markdown for a GitHub issue or wiki, export it as a Markdown file, print it, or use 'Export all boards (ZIP)' which saves every board as text, JSON and CSV in its own folder with a README. A stats bar shows total cards, cards completed this week, and average time in column.
